# Access the admin console

The admin console provides a web-based administrative interface for managing and monitoring your Terraform Enterprise installation. To access the admin console, you must authenticate using a valid API token with elevated privileges for administration tasks.

## Admin console access modes

Terraform Enterprise supports multiple access modes for the admin console, configured using the [`TFE_ADMIN_CONSOLE_ACCESS_MODE`](/terraform/enterprise/deploy/reference/configuration#tfe_admin_console_access_mode) environment variable:

@include 'admin-console-access-modes-table.mdx'

## Generate an admin API token

To generate a token for the admin console, refer to [Generate a system API token](/terraform/enterprise/deploy/reference/cli#generate-a-system-api-token) in the CLI reference documentation.

## Access the admin console

The admin console URL depends on your configured access mode:

### Dedicated port access (default)

When `TFE_ADMIN_CONSOLE_ACCESS_MODE` is set to `port`:

1. Navigate to the dedicated admin console URL:

   ```
   https://<your-tfe-hostname>:<admin_console_port>
   ```

2. When prompted, enter your admin API token to authenticate.

3. After successful authentication, you can access the administrative features.

### Standard HTTPS path access

When `TFE_ADMIN_CONSOLE_ACCESS_MODE` is set to `path` or `both`:

1. Navigate to the standard HTTPS admin console URL:

   ```
   https://<your-tfe-hostname>/platform/admin
   ```

2. When prompted, enter your admin API token to authenticate.

3. After successful authentication, you can access the administrative features.

Note: When `TFE_ADMIN_CONSOLE_ACCESS_MODE` is set to `both`, the above access is also valid.

### Shared session behavior

When `TFE_ADMIN_CONSOLE_ACCESS_MODE` is set to `both`, a single sign-in session is shared across both entry points. Logging in on the dedicated port is honored on the standard HTTPS path, and vice versa.

@include 'admin-console-both-mode-security.mdx'

You can use the admin console to perform the following tasks:

Refer to [admin console](/terraform/enterprise/deploy/configuration/admin-console) for information about the features available.
